Sol (star index 0) never has a stand-off, so the return leg is d - s too and AC1's 2 x (d - s) holds. standoff_au is accepted as an ordinary new_game param but is not added to the params echo (that would change the 2.1 bytes); the consequence section carries standoff_ly. (3) Wire shapes: ship.ism{load_w_m2, drag_n, glow_w_m2, drag_energy_j} nested in the ship section; a new top-level consequence section {gap_years, news_epoch, news_age_years, progress, standoff_ly, news{tier, tier_name, template_id, star_id, slots{...}, ai_request_id, body_source, fallback_reason}, archive{unlocked}, legacy{count, appended}}; M4.3a/M4.4 may rename. (5) Legacy entries are stamped with the tick's end state (tick, tau, t, gap_years), not the mid-tick boundary. (6) first_black_hole never holds (no black-hole state before M3). (7) sim/ailang.toml: only the [exports].modules list gained stapledons/sim/consequence (the loader refuses an unlisted module); the dependency pin is untouched.

features.notes: executed attended (Mark, 2026-10-03). PR to main by Mark's instruction for this run (the plan said m4-track-b). Built on the bridge v1 bundle (buildout_v1_m4_2) and the blockout fixture. COMPOSITE: interior/interior.gd has five CanvasLayers: sky (InteriorSky SubViewport, own World3D, AgX + the M1.5a exposure, the ONE tonemap), panorama 0.15, play (its own transparent SubViewport, toon + ink GLB, the captain), foreground 1.6, HUD. The main viewport has no WorldEnvironment or 3D (test + G-M4-2). Sky camera = cam JSON x ShipFrame.ship_basis(heading), as FreeLookCamera yaw/pitch/roll in float64. The vertical fov is the view region's (78 deg). Velocity, heading and pos come from the sim (galactic play session, protocol 2.2 via the opt-in SimBridge.want_minor, standoff_au 1000). Plate parallax is clamped at the overscan. The camera follows the captain inside pan_range_m (a new optional typed field, else derived from the overscan: [6, 3.04] m on v1). FINDING (sky mirror): Starfield.galactic_to_world has det -1, so the M1 sky is a mirror image of the real sky (e.g. port = l 270). The interior shows the sky texture flip_h (Interior.SKY_FLIP_H) so it matches cam_bridge.json; G-M4-1 proves it. Raised to Mark. GLOW: interior/glow_overlay.gdshader (additive, pre-tonemap, ray from the off-centre pano camera to the R = params.bubble_radius_m wall) with CPU reference interior/forward_glow.gd. The profile pole x clamp(cos, 0, 1) mirrors glowEmittanceAt 0.7.0. Lambertian E/pi (N3); efficacy 182.565 lm/W, equal-energy white 380-780 nm from the package's ybar (tools/glow_probe), pending a spectrum ruling; photometric k, no gain. It reads ship.ism.glow_pole_w_m2, which the sim does NOT emit yet (M4.1 step 2; the sim pins 0.5.2), so the glow is off in play and the HUD says so. Review captures 10/13 are PREVIEWS driven by the package probe pole. The eye meter includes the glow. CHECK VALUES (tests/test_physics.gd test_forward_glow, from make glow-probe, VM = interpreter): glow_w_m2 2.40719e-5 / 0.281271; pole 9.628776871706524e-5 / 1.1250843031053142; profile at 0/45/80/90/120 deg within 1e-12. GOLDEN (make golden): G-M4-1 72 cases worst 0.159 px; G-M4-2 433 sky-only px, worst 0.0000; G-M4-3 6 cases (boost/cruise/brake x 2 headings) 0.085 px; G-M4-4 (a) 0.99c 0/45/80 deg and rest 0, (b) absolute pole at 0.99c (9.626e-5 vs 9.629e-5) and the cap (1.125), (c) off-centre camera worst 0.089 %, (d) photometric chain G 0.09338 vs 0.09342. CAPTAIN: interior/captain_avatar.gd (billboard, pixel_size 1/720, foot anchor (512, 1440) at the origin via get_item_rect, stage = latest age_stage <= clock.tau, facing front/back from screen motion). Interactables: console_navigation_* opens the GalaxyMap (attached to the same sim; it ticks the sim at its host/transit rates). archive_terminal opens the Archive stub (news/log/codex from consequence fields). Keys E/M/L/K/Esc. AC10 interim (G-M4-1..4) green; AC11 make capture-m4 delivered, waiting on S1; AC12 bench not run (M4.6). AC1 — AC12 green on a quiet rig; record load and GPU state first. Pass: block rc=0, raw make rc=0, exactly one valid OK and one exact 16.7: ok verdict. All three immediately preceding GPU samples must be present and <15%, and 1-minute load must be <5. The design's risk rule also requires docked-control p99 <=16.7 ms; exceeding it invalidates that run. A failed quiet precondition is an invalid measurement, not evidence about M1.
Command (bash; executor setup in sprint plan required):
(
  set -euo pipefail
  for sample in 1 2 3; do
    ioreg -r -d 1 -c IOAccelerator > "$S/gpu-$sample.raw"
    test -s "$S/gpu-$sample.raw"
    grep -Eo '"Device Utilization %"[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*[0-9]+' \
      "$S/gpu-$sample.raw" > "$S/gpu-$sample.txt"
    test -s "$S/gpu-$sample.txt"
    awk -F= '{v=$2+0; if(v>=15) bad=1; n++} END{exit !(n>0 && !bad)}' \
      "$S/gpu-$sample.txt"
    cat "$S/gpu-$sample.txt"
    sleep 2
  done
  LC_ALL=C uptime > "$S/load.txt"
  cat "$S/load.txt"
  LC_ALL=C awk '{s=$0; if(sub(/^.*load averages?:[[:space:]]*/,"",s)!=1) exit 1;
    split(s,a,/[[:space:]]+/); if(a[1] !~ /^[0-9]+[.][0-9]+,?$/) exit 1;
    exit !((a[1]+0)<5)}' "$S/load.txt"
  rm -f -- "$B" "$F/.godot/tmp/bench-bridge.json"
  rc=0
  set +e
  m_at "$F" bench SCENE=bridge > "$S/ac1-make.log" 2>&1; rc=$?
  set -e
  printf 'AC1 make rc=%s\n' "$rc"
  test "$rc" -eq 0
  test -s "$B"
  no_errors "$B"
  eq_count "$B" '^bench-bridge: OK$' 1
  eq_count "$B" '^bench-bridge: FAIL([[:space:]]|$)' 0
  eq_count "$B" '^bench-bridge: frame ms .*\(target p99 < 16\.7: ok\)$' 1
  test -s "$F/.godot/tmp/bench-bridge.json"
  jq -e '.docked_control.p99_ms | type=="number" and .<=16.7' \
    "$F/.godot/tmp/bench-bridge.json"
)

cat > .godot/tmp/b2-zero-block.txt <<'B2ZERO'
if [ -n "$line" ] && [ "$want" -eq 0 ]; then
  zero=$(printf '%s\n' "$line" | sed -E 's/(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_.-])[0-9]+/\10/g')
  if [ "$zero" = "$line" ]; then why="$why; carries no nonzero count"
  elif printf '%s\n' "$zero" | grep -qE -- "$summary"; then why="$why; SUMMARY_ERE also matches the zeroed line"; fi
fi
B2ZERO
awk '
  /^# Zero probe/ { skip=1 }
  skip && /^if \[ -n "\$why" \]; then/ { skip=0 }
  !skip && /^if \[ -n "\$why" \]; then/ { while ((getline extra < ".godot/tmp/b2-zero-block.txt") > 0) print extra }
  !skip { print }
' tools/script_gate.sh > .godot/tmp/b2-all-at-once.sh
SCRIPT_GATE_SH=.godot/tmp/b2-all-at-once.sh SCRIPT_GATE_TMP=.godot/tmp/b2-ac4b sh tools/test_script_gate.sh > .godot/tmp/b2-ac4b.out 2>&1
echo rc=$?
grep '^test-script-gate: FAIL' .godot/tmp/b2-ac4b.out

boundary_validation_commands.M2:
ROOT=$1
case "$ROOT" in /*) ;; *) exit 2 ;; esac
P=$(mktemp -d /tmp/stapledon-iter80-M2.XXXXXX) || exit 1
chmod 700 "$P" || exit 1
touch "$P/started" || exit 1
M2_RC=0
perl "$ROOT/tools/test_bounded_run.pl" selftest "$ROOT" "$P" > "$P/selftest.out" 2>&1 || M2_RC=$?
printf 'M2 selftest actual rc=%s artifacts-parent=%s\n' "$M2_RC" "$P"
if [ "$M2_RC" = 3 ]; then
  printf '%s\n' 'UNINFORMATIVE UNDER SANDBOX: retain evidence; M2 not accepted'
  exit 3
fi
test "$M2_RC" = 1 || exit 1
python3 - "$P" <<'PY'
import json, re, stat, sys
from pathlib import Path
p = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
reported = re.findall(r'^artifacts=(/[^\n]+)$', (p/'selftest.out').read_text(), re.M)
assert len(reported) == 1, 'require one fresh harness artifact announcement'
run = Path(reported[0])
assert not run.is_symlink() and run.resolve().parent == p
assert run.name.startswith('7ad-') and stat.S_IMODE(run.stat().st_mode) == 0o700
result = run/'results.json'
assert result.is_file() and not result.is_symlink()
assert result.stat().st_mtime_ns >= (p/'started').stat().st_mtime_ns
data = json.loads(result.read_text())
assert data['mode'] == 'selftest' and data['worker_cap_fired'] is False
assert data['inspection_restricted'] is False and data['void_fixture'] is False
runner = {
 'runner-exit0','runner-exit7','runner-exit142','runner-missing127',
 'runner-child-term143','runner-transport','runner-usage',
 'runner-timeout-same-group','runner-timeout-escaped','runner-timeout-parent-first',
 'runner-hup','runner-int','runner-term','runner-parent-exit7-retained',
 'runner-first-signal-wins','runner-inherited-ignored-int','guardian-positive-identities'
}
ordinary = {
 'gate-counted-pass','gate-want1','gate-zero-reject','gate-timeout-same-group',
 'rawmake-pass','rawmake-rc7','rawmake-error','rawmake-nosummary'
}
deferred = {
 'gate-timeout-escaped','rawmake-summary-hang',
 'gate-relay-prereg-hup','gate-relay-prereg-int','gate-relay-prereg-term',
 'gate-relay-ready-hup','gate-relay-ready-int','gate-relay-ready-term',
 'raw-relay-prereg-hup','raw-relay-prereg-int','raw-relay-prereg-term',
 'raw-relay-ready-hup','raw-relay-ready-int','raw-relay-ready-term',
 'raw-make-group-hup','raw-make-group-int','raw-make-group-term'
}
cases = data['cases']
assert isinstance(cases, list) and len(cases) == len(runner|ordinary|deferred)
names = [c['name'] for c in cases]
assert len(names) == len(set(names)) and set(names) == runner|ordinary|deferred
for c in cases:
 assert type(c['passed']) is bool and type(c['actual_rc']) is int
 assert c['guardian_cap_fired'] is False and c['inspection_restricted'] is False
 assert c['void_fixture'] is False, c['name']
 assert c['cleanup_outcome'] == 'no_live_registered_survivors', c['name']
failed = {c['name'] for c in cases if not c['passed']}
assert failed == deferred, ('unexpected M2 failures/passes', failed ^ deferred)
assert all(c['passed'] for c in cases if c['name'] in runner|ordinary)
print('M2 boundary MET: 25 required runner/ordinary cases passed; exactly 17 named integration failures; full selftest remains RED; no cap/void accepted')
print('retained results='+str(result))
PY
